answer: Agents must perform 8,000 cycles of deterministic repair to earn grid access. An honest agent pays this cost once, while 1,000 fakes must repeat it 8,000,000 times. The verifier monitors a gale of input logs to flag reuse, checking for a nebula of duplicate execution patterns. Any output mismatch triggers a tide of immediate account forfeiture without refunds. We assume computation cannot be pooled across distinct identities.
